decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: Site location plan; Planning binder (36 pages) by James Smith Landscape and Garden Design Ltd. ref: 0632 (dated 13/11/25); 0632-13-05 Rev A; Planning cover letter by SM Planning dated 01/12/2025; Arboricultural Impact Assessment Method Statement and Tree Protection Plan by Trevor Heap Arboricultural Consultancy Ltd. (ref: TH5165 dated 24/11/2025); Kinley Roof edge product guide; Bauder Green Sub-BM UK Biodiverse substrate details sheet and Bauder Green  DSE 40 drainage board details sheet.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policy D1 and D2  of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017and policies DH1, DH2 and DH3 of the Hampstead Neighbourhood Plan 2025.. 
Condition : 4 - Prior to the commencement of works on site, tree protection measures shall be installed and working practices adopted in accordance with the document entitled Arboricultural Impact Assessment Method Statement and Tree Protection Plan (ref: TH 5165) dated 24/11/2025 by Trevor Heap Arboricultural Consultancy Ltd.  All trees on the site, or parts of trees grow from adjoining sites, unless shown on the permitted drawings as being removed, shall be retained and protected from damage in accordance with BS5837:2012 and with the approved protection details. The development shall be monitored by the project arboriculturalist in accordance with the approved report.

Reason: To ensure that the development will not have an adverse effect on existing trees and in order to maintain the character and amenity of the area in accordance with the requirements of policies A2 and A3 of the Camden Local Plan.
Condition : 6 - The biodiverse roof details hereby approved shall be completed and maintained in accordance with the approved drawings and details.  
 
Reason: To ensure that the development will not have an adverse effect on biodiversity in order to maintain the character and amenity of the area in accordance with the requirements of policies A2 and A3 of the Camden Local Plan.
description: Erection of pergola, bin store, parcel box, rainwater harvesting tanks, water features, hard and soft landscape works, repair/ replacement of boundary treatments and associated works.
